component.name: CONV2
component.summary: Cross-platform FFMPEG GUI for quick video conversion

description.p: CONV2 is a modern, user-friendly video converter that harnesses the power of FFmpeg to convert your videos quickly and efficiently. With support for hardware acceleration and a variety of presets, converting videos has never been easier.

ul.li: Multiple conversion presets: AV1, H.264, H.265/HEVC, Remux, GIF, and Audio extraction
Hardware acceleration support: NVIDIA NVENC, AMD AMF, Intel Quick Sync, and Apple VideoToolbox
Batch conversion queue with per-file status, CPU fallback, and retry for failed items
Real-time progress with ETA, speed, and taskbar/dock integration
Dark, Light, and Custom theme packs; optional completion notifications
Native menus on Windows and macOS; custom title bar on Windows and macOS
Configurable output directory and in-app updates (stable/beta channels)
